_note: A story built for *playing*, not for loading. `minimal_story.json` exercises
every corner of the schema, which makes it a poor thing to drive an engine
with: it has a Chance in the hall, so every run against it depends on the
seed, and its options shift underneath you as state changes.
This one is deliberately small and completely deterministic -- no Chance
anywhere -- so a test can say 'take option 2' and mean it. Every structural
feature the engine has a rule about appears exactly once, and the prose is
written to be identified, not to be read.
